training.tiePreference: First exact mean-score tie: lower C then lower unknown weight
training.sampleWeighting: Equal total per class; equal groups within class; equal clips within class/group; unknown class multiplier; mean weight normalized to 1

developmentAudit.limitation: Descriptive clip-level intervals omit group/collection dependence and field-domain uncertainty; this is development evidence, not a fresh final test.

preprocessingContract.normalization: Float64 sequential squared sum and sqrt, then Float32 coordinate division
preprocessingContract.preprocessing: Transformers.js4.3.1 ClapFeatureExtractor: five seconds input plus five seconds zero padding

limitations: No fresh final test was evaluated.
Explicit background training does not represent every possible unknown sound.
Integer head parity requires identical quantized inputs; encoder/runtime drift remains an independent gate.
The one-quantum guard is a fixed representation bound, not a bound on encoder drift or acceptance-bit invariance.
Scores and margins are not calibrated probabilities or equipment/source identity.
Browser parity, independent field validation, licensing and a fresh frozen final test are required before promotion.
